_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "All your marketing was linked to the gumroad page. That means you need to update all those links. But do you honestly know and control where those links are? I don't think you will. There will be people mentioning it in Reddit comments, reddit posts, IH comments, Hacker News comments, slack messages... Changing to a competitor is probably going to result in lost sales if you've got any decent traction in social media."
